questions.question: How long does a refund take?
questions.answer: A refund usually takes five to ten business days to appear on your bank statement.

questions.question: How do I reset my password?
questions.answer: To reset your password, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter the email address you registered with.

questions.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
questions.answer: To enable two-factor authentication, open Profile > Security > Two-factor authentication, scan the QR code with your authenticator app, and confirm with the first code. Save the ten backup codes somewhere safe; each works once.

questions.question: Where can I download my invoices?
questions.answer: You can download your invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoice history.

questions.question: How do I invite teammates?
questions.answer: Owners and admins can invite teammates by going to Settings > Members > Invite and entering one or more email addresses and choosing a role for the new members.

questions.question: Which browsers are supported?
questions.answer: The web app supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

questions.question: What is the maximum attachment size?
questions.answer: The maximum attachment size is 25 MB.

questions.question: How do I create an API key?
questions.answer: To create an API key, go to Settings > Developers > API keys and give it a descriptive name.

questions.question: How do I export my data as CSV?
questions.answer: Workspace owners can export all tickets, comments and attachments from Settings > Data > Export. Choose CSV for spreadsheets.

questions.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.answer: Workspace owners can cancel their subscription by going to Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription.

questions.question: When is the support team available?
questions.answer: The support team is available Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 20:00 CET.

questions.question: How do I upgrade my plan?
questions.answer: You can move between the Starter, Team, and Enterprise plans at any time from Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately.

questions.question: Is my data encrypted at rest?
questions.answer: Yes, your data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.

questions.question: Where is the status page for outages?
questions.answer: The status page for outages is at status.example.com.

questions.question: Why does the API return 429 Too Many Requests?
questions.answer: The API returns 429 Too Many Requests because the number of requests per minute per API key has been exceeded.

questions.question: Can I get my money back?
questions.answer: Yes, you can get your money back through the refund process.

questions.question: I forgot my login details
questions.answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and choose "Forgot password." Enter the email address you registered with, and we will send a reset link that expires after one hour.

questions.question: How do I stop being charged every month?
questions.answer: To stop being charged every month, Workspace owners can cancel their subscription from Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. This action stops automatic renewal and prevents further billing.

questions.question: My card expired, how do I put in a new one?
questions.answer: To update your payment method, go to Settings > Billing > Payment method and choose "Replace".

questions.question: Can a colleague get access to our account?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: How can I make someone an admin?
questions.answer: To make someone an admin, open Settings > Members, choose the member, and select "Admin" as the new role.

questions.question: Is there a cap on how often my integration can call you?
questions.answer: Yes, your integration can call you up to 600 times per minute per API key.

questions.question: How can I get all our tickets into a spreadsheet?
questions.answer: Workspace owners can export all tickets, comments, and attachments from Settings > Data > Export. Choose CSV for spreadsheets or JSON for importing into another system.

questions.question: Edits on my phone don't show up on my laptop
questions.answer: If changes made on the mobile app do not appear on the web, pull down on the ticket list to force a sync, and check that the app is updated to the latest version.
